Lessons.Title: All Kinds of Attributes (optional)
ExplanationParagraphs:
Learning goal: You will the purpose of this optional lesson is for you to use what you know about symmetry and parallel and perpendicular lines to complete or draw figures with those attributes on a grid.
This lesson is optional because it synthesizes all the sorting and classifying you have done up to this point. Grids are given here to encourage you to support your parallel lines, perpendicularity, and measurements and to support also thinking about attributes of figures.

2021 source lesson activities: Warm-up: How Many Do You See: Dot after Dot (10 minutes); Activity 1: You’re Gonna Draw It: It’s Symmetric (20 minutes); Activity 2: Hidden Shapes (10 minutes); Cool-down: Can You See It? (5 minutes)
Source-goal geometric reasoning: Draw a figure satisfying all stated constraints together, including specific symmetry axes and parallel/perpendicular segments.

Edulytics worked explanation: Identify all source construction constraints before drawing. Add grid segments to the original parallel pair to create a closed figure. Check all lines of symmetry and pairs of parallel or perpendicular segments, adjusting the figure if necessary.
First-party Edulytics Cool-down (not gated original): Draw an isosceles trapezoid with one line of symmetry and one pair of parallel sides.
Original student diagrams, teacher card sorting, paper folding, and physical drawings require figure-by-figure / teacher validation.
